newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cash soymeal - Basis offers firm on exports.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cash soymeal - Basis offers firm on exports.

text.p: Robust export sales and continued tight supplies of soymeal for spot delivery in cash markets were helping to keep basis offers firm Thursday, soymeal brokers said.
"As you roll into the end of harvest, supplies generally tighten," a Minnesota broker said. "As far as exports, we're (the U.S.) the only game in town for meal and beans."
USDA reported Thursday morning that soymeal exports during the week ended October 31 were 146,700 tonnes, and most brokers said they were pleased to see meal exports continue at a brisk pace.

Cash sources were also expecting the weekly crush to surpass a record 30 million bushels. Estimates ranged from 29.00 to 31.00 million bushels, and many see the crush continuing to trend higher in coming weeks.
"With the export markets as hot as they are and the bean basis slipping a bit, I can't see them leveling off anytime soon," one Indiana broker said.
Basis offers were expected to move higher next week. Some meal traded in Indiana at 17.00 cents over CBOT December futures for delivery next week, a cash source said.
